concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-mirakl-reconciliation-and-invoices]] — 2026-09-15 Mirakl seller invoice and Adyen balance-account reconciliation guide: net seller payout, commission to platform liable balance, conditional Payment Confirmation, daily BPAR and transfer references; report/status records are not independent bank-receipt proof.
warnings: Keep Mirakl seller invoice payout and commission fields tied to their distinct seller and platform liable balance-account destinations.
Pending-to-Paid behavior applies only when Payment Confirmation is enabled; invoice Paid and transfer references do not independently prove bank receipt.
The page does not define negative-payable handling, gross-to-net arithmetic, currency or time-zone conversion, or BPAR row-level schema.
